richHtml: Service bot for notifications, deal deliverables, and Favor support.

• Notify you about new requests and deal status changes.
  • Accept work-in-progress and final deliverables.
  • Create support tickets for Favor.
Send work results directly to this chat. Links, text, documents, archives, and photos will remain in the deal history and may be used as evidence in a dispute.
For a file or photo, add /result <deal ID> to its caption.
Use /report. The bot will ask for a description and let you share a contact and attach several photos.
Photos are not uploaded to Favor: the bot keeps the original messages inside Telegram.
default.text:
Favor Deals

Service bot for notifications, deal deliverables, and Favor support.

Secure Escrow deals
Send links, text, documents, archives, and photos directly to this chat — they will remain in the deal history.

Submit a deliverable:
/result <deal ID> <link or text>
For a file or photo, add /result <deal ID> to its caption.

Report a problem
Use /report. You can provide a description, contact, and several photos. Photos stay inside Telegram and are not uploaded to Favor.

start.notifications:
Favor Bot notifications are enabled.

You will now receive service messages about new deals, status changes, and final reviews here.
start.subscription:
Favor Plus subscriptions are managed in the Mini App.

Open Favor settings to pay with Telegram Stars.
start.deal:
Opening deal #{dealId}.

In Favor you can view its status, open the deal card, and contact the other party.

To submit a deliverable, send:
/result {dealId} <your link or text>
Or attach a file and add this caption: /result {dealId}
start.contract:
Opening contract "{slug}".

From the contract page you can view the details and initiate a deal.

report.defaultIntro:
Describe the problem in one or more messages. You may share a contact and attach up to 10 photos — they will remain only in Telegram and will not be uploaded to Favor.

An up-to-date preview with a submit button will appear after each step.
